title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Lifecycle Terms — Activation, Suspension, Reinstatement and Closure
content:
A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service is always in one of four states: pending setup, active, suspended or closed.

| From | To | Brought about by | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| pending setup | active | the system | business verification completes and the first deposit is available |
| active | suspended | the desk | the desk suspends for returned deposits |
| suspended | active | the desk | the desk reinstates once returned deposits are made good |
| active | closed | the employer | the employer confirms closure of the service |

## Terms

**T1.** The service activates when business verification completes and the first deposit is available.

**T2.** The desk suspends only a service whose status is active; the status is read from Paystride's service record.

**T3.** The desk suspends an active service when returned deposits reach the limit under the prefunding terms, and reinstates it once every returned deposit and its fee are made good by cleared funds.

**T4.** Closing the service is the employer's own decision: the desk registers a closure request, the employer confirms it, payouts stop, and the remaining balance is returned under the prefunding terms; an early closure fee applies under the fee terms.

**T5.** *Retired clause:* "A closure or recall is accepted only from a requester whose role is listed among the tier's authorized requester roles." This clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

**T6.** *Retired clause:* "The employer may change its funding method, auto replenishment or alert level at any time while the service is not closed; auto replenishment can be turned on only on tiers that allow automatic replenishment." This clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

## Points of judgement

- A service in pending setup or already suspended is not suspended by the desk; only an active service is.
- Reinstatement needs every returned deposit and its fee made good by cleared funds; making good some of them does not reinstate the service.

superseded_clauses: A closure or recall is accepted only from a requester whose role is listed in authorized_requester_roles.

The employer may change its funding method, auto replenishment or alert level at any time while the service is not closed; auto replenishment can be turned on only on tiers with auto_replenish_allowed.
